app.ready: http://127.0.0.1:4173/list returns HTTP 200; stdout prints Ready with that URL
app.stop: Press Ctrl+C in the terminal that started npm start; if launched programmatically, terminate only the server process you started and await its exit.

behaviour.name: Add a reading-list title
reach: Open /list; reload to begin with an empty in-memory list.
Enter Dune in Title and click Add title once; expect exactly one Dune row.
Submit an empty title; expect Enter a title. and no list change.
Enter spaces only and submit; expect the same validation and no list change.
Enter another valid title after the error; expect one additional row and cleared validation.
